'''Tie:''' {{legend0|#AE8BB1|50%}} {{legend0|#808080|No votes}} | title = Governor | before_election = [[Dave Freudenthal]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Dave Freudenthal]] | after_party = Democratic Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsWY}} The '''2006 Wyoming gubernatorial election''' took place on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Democratic Governor [[Dave Freudenthal]] won re-election in a landslide over Republican Ray Hunkins, becoming the first Democrat since [[1910 Wyoming gubernatorial election|1910]] to win every county in the state. To date, this was the last time a Democrat was elected to statewide office in Wyoming, the last time a Democrat carried every county in the state, the last gubernatorial election in which a Democrat received more than 30% of the vote, and the last statewide election in which a Democrat won any county besides [[Teton County, Wyoming|Teton]], [[Albany County, Wyoming|Albany]], [[Laramie County|Laramie]], or [[Sweetwater County, Wyoming|Sweetwater]]. ==Democratic primary== ===Candidates=== *[[Dave Freudenthal]], incumbent [[governor of Wyoming]] *Al Hamburg, perennial candidate ===Results=== {{Election box begin no change | title = Democratic primary results{{cite web |title=Democratic Statewide Candidates Official Summary - Wyoming Primary Election - August 22, 2006 |url=https://sos.wyo.gov/Elections/Docs/2006/06Results/D_Statewide_Candidate_Summary.pdf |publisher=Wyoming Secretary of State}} }} {{Election box winning candidate with party link no change | candidate = Dave Freudenthal (incumbent) | party = Democratic Party (United States) | votes = 26,550 | percentage = 89.66 }} {{Election box candidate with party link no change | candidate = Al Hamburg | party = Democratic Party (United States) | votes = 3,062 | percentage = 10.34 }} {{Election box total no change | votes = 29,612 | percentage= 100.00 }} {{Election box end}} ==Republican primary== ===Candidates=== *Ray Hunkins, attorney and rancher *John H.
